senses.gloss:
mfn. (-टः-टी-टं)
Displayed, unfolded, manifest, apparent.
E.
प्र implying manifestation, and कटच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Manifested, displayed.
2 Evident, apparent.
3 Opened, expanded.
E.
प्र before कट to go, aff. क्त.

n. (-णं)
Making visible or apparent, displaying, manifesting.
E.
प्रकट, and करण making, च्चि aug.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Made manifest, open, or visible.
E.
प्रकट, and कृत made, च्चि aff.

m. (-म्पः)
Shaking, trembling.
E.
प्र before कपि to tremble, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Trembling violently.
m. (-नः)
1 Wind, air.
2 A hell.
n. (-नं)
Violent or excessive motion, great trembling.
E.
प्र implying excess, कम्पन trembling.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Shaking, trembling violently.
E.
प्र before कषि to tremble, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Shaking, agitating.
E.
प्र before कपि to tremble, causal v., शतृ aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Who or what does much or well.
m. (-रः)
1 A heap, a quantity.
2 A bundle of flowers, a nosegay.
3 Aid, assistance, friendship.
4 Usage, custom, continuance of a similar practice.
5 Respect.
6 Seduction, abduction.
n. (-रं)
Aloe wood, (Agallochum.)
f. (-री)
1 Theatrical dress or disguise, as wearing a woman's garb, &c.
2 An episodical incident in a drama.
3 An open piece of ground, the meeting of four roads, or the proper site of any magical operations.
E.
प्र before कृ to make, aff. ट.

m. (-रः)
1 Difference.
2 Similitude.
n. (-रं)
1 Sort, kind, species.
2 Way, mode, manner.
E.
प्र before कृ to do, aff. अण्.

m. (-रः)
An inclosure, a fence, a rampart, particularly a surrounding wall, &c. elevated on a mound of earth.
E.
प्र and आङ् implying initial, first, कृ to make, aff. घञ्; otherwise the prefix is considered as प्र only, the vowel being made long by the affix being घञ्.

n. (-णं)
1 An introduction, a prologue or prelude.
2 A poetical fiction or poem, in which the story and principal persons are wholly imaginary; the term is especially applied to a dramatic poem.
3 A chapter, a section, a book, a place of pausing or stopping.
4 Treating with respect.
5 Doing much or well.
f. (-णी)
A minor drama of the same character as the Prakaraṇa, but of less extent; also प्रकरणिका.
E.
प्र before कृ to make, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-शः)
Hurting, killing.
E.
प्र, कश to hurt, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
1 Like, resembling.
2 Open, manifest, blown, expanded.
3 Famous, celebrated.
4 Public.
n. adv. (-शं)
1 Openly, publicly.
2 (In dramatic language), Aloud.
m. (-शः)
1 Sunshine, lustre, light.
2 Expansion, diffusion, manifestation; the word being equally applicable to physical or moral subjects, as the blowing of a flower, diffusion of celebrity, the publicity of an event, or the manifestation of a truth.
3 A laugh, a smile.
4 Publicity.
n. (-शं)
White or bellmetal.
E.
प्र implying motion or eminence, काश to shine, aff. अच्.

m. (-र्षः)
1 Excellence, eminence, superiority.
2 Specialty, intensity, universality.
3 Absoluteness, definitiveness.
4 (In grammar,) The effect of the prefix प्र upon roots.
E.
प्र before कृश to attract, aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
Going absolutely or finally, departure.
E.
प्रकर्ष, and गमन going.

n. (-णं)
1 Drawing, attracting.
2 Ploughing, drawing furrows.
3 Excellence, superiority.
4 Realizing by the use of a pledge more than the interest of the loan.
E.
प्र before कृष to attract, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Drawn, drawn out.
2 Exceeded in profit, (the interest of the loan.)
n. (-तं)
Profit on a pledge beyond the interest of a loan.
E.
प्र before कृष to make furrows, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Done, made.
E.
प्र before कृप to be able, क्त aff.

mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं)
1 The stem of a tree, the part between the root and the branches.
2 A branch, a shoot.
3 Excellence, happiness, (or used as an attributive without admitting variation of gender,) excellent, best, happy.
E.
प्र implying excess or superiority, कम to desire, aff. ड, and the penultimate vowel made long by special rule.

m. (-रः)
A tree.
E.
प्रकाण्ड a stem, रा to get, aff. ड.

ind.
Voluntarily, willingly.
E.
प्र implying much, very, काम desire, will.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
What irradiates, what makes open or apparent, &c.
m. (-कः)
An illuminator, an expounder, an illustrator.
E.
प्रकाश to make light or evident, aff. वुन्.

m. (-ता)
A cock.
E.
प्रकाशक illuminator (the sun), and ज्ञातृ who knows.

f. (-ता)
1 Manifestation, visibility.
2 Luminousness.
E.
प्रकाश, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, प्रकाशत्वं.

n. (-नं)
1 Illuminating, giving light.
2 Making clear or manifest.
E.
प्र before, काश to shine, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Splendid, brilliant, radiant.
E.
प्र before काश to shine, शानच् aff.

m. (-त्मा)
The sun.
E.
प्रकाश light, आत्मन् self; light itself.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Evident, apparent, manifest, visible.
2 Published, promulgated.
E.
प्रकाश manifestation, इतच् aff.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Spread abroad, published, promulgated.
2 Expanded, opened.
3 Miscellaneous, mixed.
4 Scattered, dispersed.
5 Agitated, excited, wild.
6 Waved, waving.
n. (-र्णं)
1 A Chowri, a cow-tail used as a fan.
2 A chapter, a section.
3 A collection of miscellaneous rules.
E.
प्र before कृ to throw or cast, aff. क्त.

n. (-कं)
1 A Chowri, the tail of the Bos grunniens, used as a whisk or fan.
2 The section or chapter of a book.
3 Extent, length, especially of a stanza or book.
4 (In law,) A case not provided for by the Śāstras, and to be decided by the authority of the judge or king.
5 A miscellany.
6 Any collection of heterogeneous objects not arranged under any distinct classes or heads.
m. (-कः)
A horse.
E.
कन् added to प्रकीर्ण.

f. (-र्त्तिः)
1 Fame, celebrity.
2 Declaration.
E.
प्र before कॄ to scatter, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Declared, explained, said, revealed.
2 Celebrated, renowned.
E.
प्र before कॄ to scatter, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
To be spread abroad or about, to be diffused, promulgated, expanded, or extended.
m. (-र्य्यः)
A plant, (Cæsalpinia bonducella.)
E.
प्र progressive motion, कॄ to throw or cast, aff. यक्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Enraged, incensed.
2 Disordered.
E.
प्र before कुप to be angry, क्त aff.

mfn. (-र्व्वन्-र्व्वती-र्व्वत्)
1 Behaving respectfully to, waiting upon, serving, honouring.
2 Doing much or well.
E.
प्र before कृ to do, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Attending, or behaving to with respect.
2 Doing much or well.
E.
प्र, and कृ to make, शानच् aff.

n. (-लं)
A handsome or excellent body.
E.
प्र excellent, कुल the body; also read प्रह्वल.

m. (-लः)
The tip of Kusa grass placed to the east.
E.
प्राक्, and कूल point of grass.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Made, completed, accomplished.
2 Commenced.
3 Continuing or engaged in what has been begun.
4 Wished, expected.
5 Important, interesting.
E.
प्र before कृत done.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Low, common, vulgar, thence especially applicable to a provincial and peculiar dialect of the Sanskrit language.
2 Natural.
3 Belonging to or derived from the philosophical Prakṛti, illusory, material, &c.
m. (-तः)
A low man or one following a degraded profession.
n. (-तं)
Any dialect not Sanskrit, it is especially spoken by the female characters and the inferior personages of plays.
E.
प्रकति nature, and अण् aff., or प्र pre-eminently, and अकृत not made.

f. (-तिः)
1 Nature; in philosophy, the passive or material cause of the world, as opposed to the active or spiritual; and in mythology, a goddess, the personified will of the Supreme in the creation, identified with Māyā or illusion, and in an especial manner the prototype of the female sex; hence it is the same with the Śakti or personified energy or bride of a deity, as LAKṢMĪ, DURGĀ, &c. in some systems Prakṛti is considered the same with the Supreme Being.
2 The natural state or condition of any thing.
3 A radical form or predicament of being, as illusion, intelligence, consciousness, and the five elements, or Ākāśa, fire, air, earth, and water.
4 The five elements collectively.
5 Cause, origin.
6 A woman or womankind.
7 A mother.
8 An animal.
9 The male organ of generation.
10 The female organ of generation.
11 An uninflected word; the radical form of a word, before the affixes forming cases, &c. are subjoined.
12 A requisite of regal administration, of which seven are enumerated; the king, the minister, an ally, treasure, territory, fortresses, and an army: the corporations or companies of citizens are sometimes added, making an eighth class.
13 A form of metre, consisting of a stanza of four lines, each line containing twenty-one syllables.
14 (In arithmetic,) A given coefficient. (In anatomy,) Temperament, the predominance of one of the humours at the time of generation.
E.
प्र implying priority or precedence, कृ to make, aff. क्तिन् or क्तिच्; being the first step towards creation.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Volatile, fickle.
E.
प्रकृति nature, and तरल changing.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
1 Natural, genuine, unmixed.
2 Inherent, innate.
E.
प्रकृति, and स्थ what is.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Thin, emaciate.
E.
प्र before कृश to be thin, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Chief, principal, pre-eminent.
2 Remote, far, long (as a road).
E.
प्र eminently, कृश to attract, aff. क्त.

n. (-त्वं)
Eminence, superiority.
E.
प्रकृष्ट, and त्व aff.; also with तल् aff. प्रकृष्टता.

m. (-पः)
Irritation, provocation, enraging.
E.
प्र before कुप to be angry, causal v., घञ् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be incensed or enraged.
E.
प्र before कुप to be angry, causal v., अनीयर् aff. and the न optionally changed; also प्रकोपनीय.

n. (-नं)
Irritating, provoking.
E.
प्र before कुप to be angry, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Irritated, provoked.
E.
प्र before कुप to be angry, causal v., क्त aff.

m. (-ष्ठः)
1 The fore-arm.
2 Part of the frame of a door.
3 A court in a house, or open space surrounded by buildings.
E.
प्र before कुष to draw, स्थन् aff.

m. (-रः)
A horse's armour; also प्रखर and प्रक्षर.

mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ)
1 Who proceeds or goes.
2 Conquering, overpowering, surpassing.
3 Who begins, a beginner.
E.
प्र before क्रम to go, तृच् aff.

m. (-मः)
1 Proceeding, going.
2 Leisure, opportunity.
3 Beginning.
4 Surpassing, overcoming.
E.
प्र first or most, क्रम to go, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be gone or proceeded.
E.
प्र before क्रम to go, अनीयर् aff.; also प्रक्रमितव्य and प्रक्रम्य.

(-णः-णा-णं)
1 Proceeding.
2 Beginning.
3 Overcoming.
E.
प्र before क्रम to go.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Gone, proceeded.
2 Gone beyond, surpassed.
3 Begun.
E.
प्र before क्रम to go, क्त aff.

f. (-या)
Bearing royal insignia.
E.
प्र principal, क्रिया business.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Playing, sporting.
E.
प्र before, क्रीड to play, क्त aff.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Made, prepared.
2 Mixed.
E.
प्र before कृप to make, क्त aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Satisfied.
2 Wet, soaked.
E.
प्र excess, क्लिद to wet, aff. क्त.

m. (-णः)
The sound of the Vīṇā or lute.
E.
प्र principal, क्वण to sound, aff. अप्; also प्रक्वाण.

m. (-णः)
The sound of the Vīṇā or lute.
E.
प्र before क्वण to sound, aff. घञ्.

m. (-रः)
Iron armour for the defence of a horse or elephant.
E.
प्र best, क्षर to go, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what washes.
E.
प्र before क्षल to cleanse, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-नं)
Cleaning, washing.
E.
प्र thoroughly, क्षल r. 10th cl. to clean, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Washed, cleansed.
E.
प्र before क्षल r. 10th cl. to clean, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Thrown, cast, hurled.
E.
प्र before क्षिप to throw, क्त aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Throwing, having thrown.
E.
प्र before क्षिप to throw, क्तवतु aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Decayed, wasting.
E.
प्र before क्षि to waste, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Intoxicated.
E.
प्र before क्षीव to be drunk, क्त aff.

m. (-पः)
1 Throwing, casting.
2 Throwing into or upon.
3 Any thing added, or thrown in to drugs when in course of decoction.
E.
प्र before क्षिप to throw, घञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
Throwing, casting.
E.
प्र before क्षिप to throw, aff. ल्युट्.

mf. (-नः-ना)
1 An iron arrow.
2 Clamour, a loud indistinct noise.
E.
प्र especially, क्ष्विद to sound indistinctly, aff. ल्यु, deriv. irr.; otherwise प्रक्ष्वेदन.

mf. (-नः-ना)
1 An iron arrow.
2 Calling aloud, clamour:
E.
see the last.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Clamorous, shouting, making a loud indistinct noise.
2 Unctuous.
E.
प्र before, क्ष्विद to sound, क्त aff.; also read प्रक्ष्वेडित.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Noisy.
2 Unctuous.
E.
प्र before क्ष्विद to make a noise, क्तवतु aff.

ind.
1 Before, prior, preceding, in place or time.
2 East, eastern.
3 Past, gone.
4 First.
5 Between, amongst, amidst.
6 At dawn, early in the morning.
E.
see प्राच्.

m. (-कः)
1 A catamite.
2 A dancer, but especially one who employs or hires the wives of others, one who gets his livelihood by another man's wife.
E.
प्र and आङ् prefixed to कष to go, Uṇādi aff. किकन्.

n. (-म्यं)
1 Irresistible will or fiat, one of ŚIVA'S eight attributes.
2 Wilfulness, following or obeying one's own will or inclination.
E.
प्र and आङ् before कम to desire, aff. ण्यत्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Walled, enclosed by a wall.
2 Of, belonging to, or fit for a wall.
E.
प्राकार, and छ aff.

m. (-रः)
Common or usual fever, occurring from affections of the wind, bile, and phlegm, severally, in as many seasons, or the rains, autumn, and spring.
E.
प्राकृत, and ज्वर fever.

m. (-यः)
The total dissolution of the world.
E.
प्राकृत material, and प्रलय destruction.

m. (-षः)
A man in general.
E.
प्राकृत, and मानुष man.

m. (-त्रः)
A natural friend or ally; as applied to a sovereign, it means one whose states are removed by an intervening [] kingdom from those to which it should be friendly, the प्राकृतारि or natural enemy is the chief of the intervening state, and the प्राकृतोदासीनः or natural neutral is the outer one of the four.
E.
प्राकृत natural, and मिच a friend.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Belonging or relating to Prakṛti, nature or matter, material, natural, illusory, &c.
E.
प्रकृति, and ठक् aff.

n. (-लं)
Former age or time.
E.
प्राच्, and काल time.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Anterior, ancient, of a former time.
E.
प्राक्काल, and ख aff.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
1 Old, ancient.
2 Prior, anterior, preceding, former.
E.
प्राक् formerly, द्युल् aff., and तन् aug.

n. (-र्म्म)
1 Fate, destiny.
2 Any act formerly done.
E.
प्राक्तन prior, and कर्म्मन् act.

f. (-णी)
The eleventh of the lunar asterisms: see पूर्व्वफल्गुण.
E.
प्राक् preceding, and फल्गुणी the asterism.

m. (-वः)
A name of VṚHASPATI.
E.
प्राक्फल्गुणी, and भय born, born when the moon was in that mansion; also similar compounds, as प्राक्फल्गुणीय.

m. (-नः)
VṚHASPATI.
E.
प्राक्फल्गुणी, and अण् aff.

f. (-न्ध्या)
Dawn.
E.
प्राक् the first, सन्ध्य junction of the day.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
1 Facing the east.
2 Having the head to the east in burial.
E.
प्राच्, and शिरम the head, मच added.
